G1_unambiguity.justification: The polynomial condition unambiguously requires the two endpoint multipliers to be distinct, which is exactly the intended conflict constraint.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement specifies all relevant bounds, input formats, validity conditions, output formats, lexicographic tie-breaking, and edge cases.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Since \(E(x)=x(x-f_u)(x-f_v)\), having exactly three distinct real roots is equivalent to \(f_u\ne f_v\), so the rewritten task is exactly the original three-coloring task.

G4_naturalness.justification: The relay and stability framing is coherent and readable, though the cubic-root construction feels somewhat contrived compared with the direct shift-assignment formulation.
